headline: Council may vote on Mayor Maria Rivera's appointment of Andrew Mello of Providence to a term expiring November 1, 2031.
summary: The Council may vote on Mayor Maria Rivera's appointment of Andrew Mello of Providence. The term is set to expire November 1, 2031.
items: Consideration of Mayor Maria Rivera's appointment of Andrew Mello of Providence to the Wyatt Detention Facility Board, term expiring November 1, 2031 (Council may vote on this item)
location: City of Central Falls, 1280 High Street, Central Falls, RI 02863
